title: Hyperia City launches: first Set 14 weekend has Amber/Emerald, Amber/Amethyst and Emerald/Steel winning, plus two big CCQs
summary: Hyperia City (Set 14: 242 cards, Coco and the new Ink Drop mechanic) went on general sale Oct. 23, a week after the Oct. 16 prereleases.

The first Set 14 Core weekend had different winners in different places. Amber/Amethyst won Heroes Ink in Germany, Amber/Emerald Songs won Top Deck Keep in the US, and Steel/Emerald Evasive won Quest Coast IV.

Two Core Constructed Qualifiers that award NAC invites ran on Oct. 24. BlingGuest won the 144-player Lorca-Breizh CCQ in France, and Darian won the 79-player Through the Decades Infinity 5K in the US.

Ravensburger revealed Collector Boosters and a new Illustrious rarity. Both arrive with Into the Inkdark on Feb. 12, 2027, and will only be sold at Ravensburger Play Hub stores, Ravensburger's online store and select Disney locations.

The Quest World Iconic Clash, a 16-player invitational where the prize is an iconic Hades – Looking for a Deal, published all 16 decklists and is releasing Round 1 matches. Amber/Emerald Songs and Emerald/Amethyst Retro are the most common decks.
